name: Dancing Lights

header.Components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Choose up to four torch/lantern/candle-like lights or combined Medium humanoid form; Dim Light radius 10 feet; Bonus Action move up to 60 feet; lights stay within 20 feet of each other and spell range.

rules.text: You create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration.
Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike.
Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10- foot radius.
As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range.
A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell’s range.
